cycle.label: Reporting period
cycle.note: Wisconsin licenses expire December 14 of odd-numbered years. CPE runs December 15 – December 14: 80 hours over the two years, at least 20 in each year, 3 of ethics.

requirements.label: Total CPE
requirements.note: 80 hours each two-year period. Up to 40 hours over the 80 from your previous period carry forward.

requirements.label: Ethics
requirements.note: 3 hours of ethics from formal learning activities each period. Regulatory and behavioral ethics both count.

byIssueYearInPeriod.note: Initial license issued 1–2 years before it expires: 40 hours, with 20 in the second year.
Initial license issued less than a year before it expires: no CPE is due at this renewal.

licenseDateHint: Wisconsin licenses expire December 14 of odd-numbered years (e.g. 12/14/2027).
issueDateHint: If your initial license was issued during this period, fewer hours (or none) are due.
limitsNotTracked: At least 40 of the 80 from formal learning activities (programs from qualifying sponsors — most courses with certificates qualify).
Carryback: hours earned in the first 12 months of a period can instead count for the previous period.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records in case of a Board audit.
toVerify: Initial license issued 1–2 years before expiration: 40 hours with 20 in the second year; the 3 ethics hours kept (sources don't say).
Carryforward measured over 80 in the previous period.
